source: 转职任务配置（手工维护，非 WZ 导出产物）。与 shared/windbell.json 同类：由服务端启动时加载并硬校验。

provenance.T: 同版 WZ 已核字段：转职官 NPC（漢斯 1032001 / 101000003）、一转等级与前置（QuestData/1402.img）、三条二转分支授予的 fixLevel 技能（源 maxLevel=1：2200011 結冰特效 / 2100009 元素吸收 / 2300009 祝福福音）。
provenance.P: 源 273 包未随附二转/三转执行脚本，目标怪物、目标道具与数量是本项目可执行化补齐，不冒充原作数值；二转 30／三转 60 的等级门槛沿用原版法师转职等级，本包无据可核，同样记为 P。技能书 210/211/230/231 的技能本体已进入装配产物（`shared/mage-skills.json` 现有 0/200/210/211/220/221/222/230/231 共 9 本、102 条），因此二转分支按源 fixLevel 事实授予 `reward.skills`，与冰雷 2200011 同构；三转分支源里没有 fixLevel 节点，故不写 reward.skills。

text.zh: 擊敗 30 隻 斧木妖

offer.zh: 想掌握火與毒，就先學會承受它們。願意接受試煉嗎？
offer.en: To command fire and poison you must first endure them. Will you take the trial?

locked.zh: 你還不夠資格。先達到 30 級，並完成法師之路。
locked.en: You are not ready. Reach level 30 and finish the Path of the Magician first.

accept.zh: 很好。去擊敗斧木妖，把它們身上的木柴帶回來給我。
accept.en: Good. Defeat the Axe Stumps and bring me their Firewood.

progress.zh: 試煉還沒有完成。回到森林把目標做完，再來找我。
progress.en: The trial is not finished yet. Complete the goals, then come back to me.

ready.zh: 你做到了。把收集的證明交給我，我現在就為你轉職。
ready.en: You did it. Hand me the proof you gathered and I will advance you now.

complete.zh: 你通過了試煉。從現在起，你就是火毒法師的試煉了。
complete.en: You have passed the trial. From now on you are the Trial of the Fire/Poison Magician.

title.en: Trial of the Fire/Poison Arch Magician

text.zh: 擊敗 30 隻 黑肥肥
收集 10 個 堅硬的羽毛

offer.zh: 火焰與劇毒已在你手中成形。要再往前一步，就得走進更深的黑暗。
offer.en: Fire and poison have taken shape in your hands. To go further you must face a deeper darkness.

locked.zh: 你還不夠資格。先達到 60 級，並完成火毒法師的試煉。
locked.en: You are not ready. Reach level 60 and finish the Fire/Poison trial first.

accept.zh: 很好。去擊敗黑肥肥，把它們身上的堅硬的羽毛帶回來給我。
accept.en: Good. Defeat the Dark Ribbon Pigs and bring me their Stiff Feathers.

progress.zh: 試煉還沒有完成。回到森林把目標做完，再來找我。
progress.en: The trial is not finished yet. Complete the goals, then come back to me.

ready.zh: 你做到了。把收集的證明交給我，我現在就為你轉職。
ready.en: You did it. Hand me the proof you gathered and I will advance you now.

complete.zh: 你通過了試煉。從現在起，你就是火毒大魔導士的試煉了。
complete.en: You have passed the trial. From now on you are the Trial of the Fire/Poison Arch Magician.

text.zh: 擊敗 30 隻 黑斧木妖
收集 10 個 遺失的斧頭

offer.zh: 想成為冰雷法師，就先證明你能掌握冰與雷。願意接受試煉嗎？
offer.en: To become an Ice/Lightning Magician you must first prove your command of ice and lightning. Will you take the trial?

locked.zh: 你還不夠資格。先達到 30 級，並完成法師之路。
locked.en: You are not ready. Reach level 30 and finish the Path of the Magician first.

accept.zh: 很好。去擊敗黑斧木妖，把它們遺失的斧頭帶回來給我。
accept.en: Good. Defeat the Dark Axe Stumps and bring me the axes they lost.

progress.zh: 試煉還沒有完成。回到森林把目標做完，再來找我。
progress.en: The trial is not finished yet. Complete the goals, then come back to me.

ready.zh: 你做到了。把收集的證明交給我，我現在就為你轉職。
ready.en: You did it. Hand me the proof you gathered and I will advance you now.

complete.zh: 你通過了試煉。從現在起，你就是冰雷法師了。
complete.en: You have passed the trial. From now on you are an Ice/Lightning Magician.

title.en: Trial of the Ice/Lightning Arch Magician

text.zh: 擊敗 30 隻 木面怪人

offer.zh: 冰與雷已經在你手中合一。要再往前一步，就得面對更深的黑暗。
offer.en: Ice and lightning are one in your hands. To go further you must face a deeper darkness.

locked.zh: 你還不夠資格。先達到 60 級，並完成冰雷法師的試煉。
locked.en: You are not ready. Reach level 60 and finish the Ice/Lightning trial first.

accept.zh: 去擊敗木面怪人，取回它們身上的木板作為證明。
accept.en: Defeat the Wooden Mask Men and bring back their wooden plates as proof.

progress.zh: 你的試煉尚未完成，繼續努力。
progress.en: Your trial is not complete yet. Keep going.

ready.zh: 木板都齊了。交給我，我現在就為你轉職。
ready.en: The plates are all here. Hand them over and I will advance you now.

complete.zh: 你已掌握冰雷的最深處。從現在起，你就是冰雷大魔導士。
complete.en: You have mastered the depths of ice and lightning. From now on you are an Ice/Lightning Arch Magician.

text.zh: 擊敗 30 隻 發芽木妖

offer.zh: 神聖的魔法不問力量，只問你願不願意承擔。要走上這條路嗎？
offer.en: Holy magic asks not for power but for willingness to bear it. Will you take this path?

locked.zh: 你還不夠資格。先達到 30 級，並完成法師之路。
locked.en: You are not ready. Reach level 30 and finish the Path of the Magician first.

accept.zh: 很好。去擊敗發芽木妖，把它們身上的苗木帶回來給我。
accept.en: Good. Defeat the Sprouting Stumps and bring me their Saplings.

progress.zh: 試煉還沒有完成。回到森林把目標做完，再來找我。

ready.en: You did it. Hand me the proof you gathered and I will advance you now.

complete.zh: 你通過了試煉。從現在起，你就是僧侶的試煉了。
complete.en: You have passed the trial. From now on you are the Trial of the Cleric.

text.zh: 擊敗 30 隻 膽小的黑肥肥
收集 10 個 堅硬的羽毛

offer.zh: 你的信仰已經被看見。再往前，就要替更多人承擔。
offer.en: Your faith has been seen. To go further you must bear it for more people.

locked.zh: 你還不夠資格。先達到 60 級，並完成僧侶的試煉。
locked.en: You are not ready. Reach level 60 and finish the Cleric trial first.

accept.zh: 很好。去擊敗膽小的黑肥肥，把它們身上的堅硬的羽毛帶回來給我。
accept.en: Good. Defeat the Timid Dark Ribbon Pigs and bring me their Stiff Feathers.

progress.zh: 試煉還沒有完成。回到森林把目標做完，再來找我。
progress.en: The trial is not finished yet. Complete the goals, then come back to me.

ready.zh: 你做到了。把收集的證明交給我，我現在就為你轉職。
ready.en: You did it. Hand me the proof you gathered and I will advance you now.

complete.zh: 你通過了試煉。從現在起，你就是祭司的試煉了。
complete.en: You have passed the trial. From now on you are the Trial of the Priest.
